name: Tuya
tagline: Cloud API for white-label smart-home and IoT devices worldwide
description: Tuya Cloud API lets developers control and manage millions of white-label consumer IoT devices (lights, plugs, locks, sensors, and more) via a multi-region REST platform. Apps and platforms use it for device linking, status, and remote control across Tuya-powered SKUs.

auth.details: Access ID and Access Secret from the Tuya IoT Platform; sign requests with HMAC-SHA256 (client_id, timestamp, nonce, signature headers). Token via GET /v1.0/token?grant_type=1.

example.request: curl -X GET "https://openapi.tuyaus.com/v1.0/token?grant_type=1" -H "client_id: YOUR_CLIENT_ID" -H "sign: YOUR_SIGN" -H "t: YOUR_TIMESTAMP" -H "sign_method: HMAC-SHA256" -H "nonce: YOUR_NONCE"

use_cases: get OAuth access token for Tuya Cloud
list devices linked to a user
get real-time status of a smart device
send a control command to a Tuya-powered device
query device functions and data points (DPs)
